title: wedelia trilobata
intro: Wedelia trilobata, commonly known as Sphagneticola trilobata or Creeping Oxeye, is a type of flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia trilobata include its ability to soothe skin irritations, treat fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
